lines.en: Saturn and Mars and Sun are indicative of violent and alien and dangerous

lines.en: matters; for they make men bold and enterprising

lines.en: in their undertakings, not keeping what they acquire, desirers of alien things,

lines.text: ἐπιθυμητάς, ἐκ κακῶν τὸν βίον πορίζοντας, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ στρατιωτικὸν
lines.en: providing their livelihood from evil deeds, unless they have a military

lines.en: or athletic figure; and even so it is laborious, but not

lines.text: ἄπρακτον.
lines.en: ineffective.

lines.text: Κρόνος καὶ Ἄρης καὶ Σελήνη παραβόλους μὲν εἴς τε τὰς ἐπιβολὰς
lines.en: Saturn and Mars and Moon make men reckless in their enterprises

lines.text: τῶν πράξεων καὶ γενναίους ἀποτελοῦσι, (f. 192) δυσεπιτεύκτους δὲ
lines.en: and actions and noble, (f. 192) but hard to succeed

lines.text: περὶ τὰς πράξεις καὶ ἐναντιώμασι περιτρεπομένους καὶ βιαίοις πράγ-
lines.en: in their actions and overturned by oppositions and violent matters.

lines.text: μασι. γίνονται γὰρ βίαιοι, φιλέρημοι, κακοῦργοι, ἅρπαγες, τρόπον
lines.en: For they become violent, solitary, evil-doers, robbers, having a piratical

lines.text: λῃστρικὸν ἔχοντες, ἔν τε ἀπολογίαις ἢ κρίσεσι περιπίπτοντες, συνοχῶν
lines.en: manner, falling into defenses or judgments, taking experience of confinements

lines.en: fond of arms (f. 271v), so that through this occupation the figure of

lines.text: συνοχῆς σχῆμα πληροφορηθῇ· τινὲς μὲν οὖν καὶ ἐπισινεῖς ἢ ἐμπαθεῖς
lines.en: confinement may be fulfilled; some then also become injured or diseased

lines.text: γινόμενοι βίαιον τὸ τέλος ἐφέξουσι.
lines.en: and will have a violent end.

lines.text: Κρόνος καὶ Ἄρης καὶ Ἀφροδίτη περὶ μὲν τὰς πράξεις καὶ τὰς
lines.en: Saturn and Mars and Venus are suitable at first for actions and

lines.text: φιλίας ἢ συναλλαγὰς κατ’ ἀρχὰς ἐπιτήδειοι, ὠφελείας, δόξας καὶ
lines.en: friendships or transactions, producing benefits, glories and

lines.text: συστάσεις ἀποτελοῦντες. ἐξ’ ὑστέρου δὲ ἐπιτάραχοι καὶ ἐπίδικοι καθίσ-
lines.en: recommendations. But later they become turbulent and litigious

lines.text: τανται διά τινας ἐπιζηλίας καὶ προδοσίας ὧν χάριν καταιτιασμοὺς μὲν
lines.en: because of some jealousies and betrayals for the sake of which they make accusations

lines.text: ποιοῦνται καὶ ἔχθρας πρός τε ἀρσενικὰ καὶ θηλυκὰ πρόσωπα ὑπομέ-
lines.en: and endure enmities towards both male and female persons

lines.text: νουσι καὶ ψόγοις ἐπαισχροῖς ἢ μοιχείαις περιτρέπονται καὶ περιβοησίας
lines.en: and are overturned by shameful blames or adulteries and infamies

summary.headline: Planetary Combinations and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary combinations: Saturn with Mars and Sun signifies violent, dangerous, lawless, alienated, and laborious lives, while Saturn with Mars and Moon brings recklessness, violence, confinement, accusations, illness, and a violent end. Saturn, Mars, and Venus initially favor actions, friendships, transactions, benefits, and honors, but later produce turbulence, litigation, jealousy, betrayal, accusations, enmity, adultery, and infamy.
